repo: The Release workflow on main creates or updates the Callisto release PR (#468) with a summary table, grouped changes, and Major/Minor/Patch layout.
A private member of a fixed group is bumped with its group but cannot be selected explicitly; selecting it in the offline publish plan fails with E169 ('configures no publish target').
`compose-pr-body --publish-plan` now uses a new `publish_outlook_in`, which plans only bumped packages that have a publish target; if none publish, the outlook is an empty plan rather than a failure.
Test fixtures in crates/callisto-cli/tests/common/mod.rs had no private fixed-group member, which is why the E169 false alarm was not caught earlier; the new test in emit_preview_tests covers it.
Changes ship with a changeset file under .changeset/ and signed commits; `just pre-push`, lint, doc-check, test and the workflow contract scripts are the verification gates.
Repo work is done in git worktrees under /Users/gabe/Projects/callisto/.claude/worktrees/.

workflow: Validate a bug-fix test by mutating the fix away and confirming it fails with the same error seen in production (failing-first / mutation check).

Confirm commit signature via the GitHub API (`commits/<sha> --jq .commit.verification.reason`).
